facts.fact: ACTPOL says Law No. 151 of 2020 was published in July 2020 and, with executive regulations dated 1 November 2025, organisations have one year to comply, bringing the regime into full effect around 1 November 2026.
facts.system: Personal Data Protection Law, Law No. 151 of 2020

facts.fact: ACTPOL says the Centre's board was not constituted as of January 2026 and an acting chief executive leads it.
ACTPOL says the executive regulations were issued as Decree No. 816 of 2025 by the Minister of Communications, dated 1 November 2025 and released publicly on 25 December 2025.
ACTPOL says the Centre presented online services for licence applications and data protection officer registration in February 2026 but had published no decisions by 25 September 2026.
ACTPOL says the executive regulations, dated 1 November 2025, were released publicly on 25 December 2025.
